verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions retention or cohort analysis in GA4. What it does show is a different story or a developer building block: funnel reporting, pivot reports and filters in the Data API, and raw BigQuery event export queried with SQL. None of these is documented retention-over-time reporting sliced by behavioral cohorts, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can measure retention over time and slice it by behavioral cohorts
